_comment: One job per STRIP — the whole strip as one image, for the concept run. Run with comic_render.py --provider runway|google|openai.

jobs.title: The Greyhound station
jobs.prompt: a full-page comic in horizontal tiers stacked top to bottom (5 tiers). Style: black and white comic strip panel, scratchy crow-quill pen and ballpoint ink on cardstock, harsh photocopy contrast, heavy black spotting, jagged uneven line weights, 1990s indie comix zine style, xerox grain, no color, no gray tones. Cast, the same faces, hair and builds in every panel, ages exactly as given: WOOD — aged 20, thin young man with a slouch, three days' stubble, dark hair grown longer; CHLOE — aged 20, girl with a sharp intelligent face, smudged heavy black eyeliner, straight dark hair to the shoulders. CHLOE wears a SSCP tee. Clothes, hair-dos and anything held come from this strip's description, never from the reference sheet; hands are empty unless a panel names what they hold. Title of the strip: DRIFT WOOD. The strip: Chloe boards the southbound bus to Eugene to connect north. Neither waves. Tier 1: a Greyhound bus with tinted windows at a roadside stop on a coastal highway in drizzle, a young woman with two bags stepping up to the door, towering black Sitka spruce behind, stark black-and-white with xerox grain (in this tier: CHLOE). No dialogue in this tier. Tier 2: a thin young man in an oversized chore coat standing outside a bus with hands deep in his pockets, a faint figure behind the tinted window, neither waving, rain (in this tier: WOOD, CHLOE). No dialogue in this tier. Tier 3: close-up of a bus door folding shut with a young man's reflection in the dark glass, rain streaks (in this tier: WOOD). No dialogue in this tier. Tier 4: a bus pulling away up a two-lane coastal highway, its taillights small, a lone figure left at the roadside stop, black spruce walls on both sides (in this tier: WOOD). No dialogue in this tier. Tier 5: two red taillights disappearing around a serpentine bend of a coastal highway swallowed by towering ink-black Sitka spruce and drizzle, no people, stark black and white. No dialogue in this tier. Lettering: every balloon and caption contains its complete text exactly as written, in clean hand-lettered comic capitals, large enough to read; size each balloon to fit its whole sentence and never cut a word at a balloon or panel edge; no words other than the ones given. Bottom right margin: tiny signature "A. Finch — Small Wood, OR" beside a tiny stylized crab, seen from above. Reference @chloe_17 is the model sheet for CHLOE: match that face, hair and build exactly; do NOT copy its clothes, pose or props — those come from the strip text above. Reference @wood_20 is the model sheet for WOOD: match that face, hair and build exactly; do NOT copy its clothes, pose or props — those come from the strip text above. Reference @gully_17 is the model sheet for GULLY: match that face, hair and build exactly; do NOT copy its clothes, pose or props — those come from the strip text above. Match the attached references: @chloe_17 for the character the strip's Chloe at 17; @wood_20 for the character Wood at 20-23; @gully_17 for the character the strip's Gully at 17.
